statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The 13:30Z US cash open is in progress and its structure is not yet verifiable on delayed quote feeds, so Tail is held in the watch band as a checkpoint on the opening auction rather than on any observed one-way path. Stress stays elevated on live 50% US tariffs on Canadian goods, the 18:00Z Treasury press conference on Iran measures and pre-NVIDIA positioning.

That pre-open shape is a completed retracement, the opposite of the repeated extension after failed pullbacks that defines the pathological path for a mean-reversion basket. What is not yet verifiable is the opening auction itself, which began minutes before this assessment, so the mapped state stays in the watch band across the previously published 13:30Z-14:30Z danger window rather than easing on unobserved evidence. No cross-asset amplifier is aligned: ES -0.16% and YM -0.15% do not confirm the Nasdaq weakness, VIX 15.91 sits near the 15.85 low of its day range, the 10-year yield is 1.8bp lower at 4.72% and WTI is 1.49% lower at $85.77 even with Iran threatening Hormuz transit. Semiconductor internals are dispersed rather than uniformly weak, with memory names lagging while NVIDIA firmed in premarket trade. Existing-position management and emergency protection are unaffected by the mapped state.
headline: Nasdaq-100: the cash open is in progress and unverified; Tail is held at the watch-band checkpoint, Stress elevated
body:
The last verified NQ futures print before this assessment was 29,214.75, down 173.00 points or 0.59%, timestamped 13:04Z against a 29,387.75 prior close. The quoted day range on that source is unchanged at 29,116.75-29,297.00, while a second source covering the full Globex session shows the same 29,116.75 low against a 29,480.50 overnight high, so the reference low is corroborated across two independent feeds.

The structural reading of the pre-open session is unchanged and remains benign for a mean-reversion basket. The 29,116.75 low was set in the early European hours and has now survived roughly six hours without a retest, with price recovering about 98 points from it and holding mid-range. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks, price pinned near a session extreme and a steadily widening range are the three signatures that would make Tail meaningful, and none of them was present in the verified record.

What this assessment cannot yet verify is the opening auction. The 13:30Z US cash open began minutes before the assessment cutoff, and the available quote feeds are delayed, so no post-open price path has been observed. The prior published assessment placed a narrow danger window across 13:30Z-14:30Z precisely because that transition is the session's first genuine opportunity to convert tech-specific weakness into one-way structure. Nothing has been observed that would invalidate that window, so the watch-band mapping is retained rather than eased on absent evidence. Equally, nothing observed justifies raising Tail: an unverified open is a checkpoint, not an amplifier.

Cross-asset confirmation is still absent. ES is 0.16% lower at 7,679.25 and YM 0.15% lower at 53,271, so the weakness stays concentrated in technology rather than broad risk-off. VIX is 15.91, up 5.16% on the day but sitting near the 15.85 low of a 15.85-16.05 range, meaning implied volatility firmed early and has since faded. The 10-year Treasury yield is 4.72%, 1.8 basis points lower, while the 2-year is 4.25% and fractionally higher, a mild flattening rather than a yield shock. WTI is $85.77, 1.49% lower, and Brent $93.29, 1.17% lower. Semiconductor internals are dispersed rather than uniformly weak: memory and storage names lagged sharply into the open while NVIDIA recovered into positive territory in premarket trade, and the latest-session megacap reading was split evenly. Dispersion of that kind conflicts with, rather than confirms, a one-way index path.

The event backdrop carries three named overhangs. The Treasury Secretary holds a press conference at 18:00Z to detail new economic measures against Iran, and Iran's security chief has publicly threatened to halt oil transit through the Strait of Hormuz and to target tankers in response. That is a genuine discontinuity risk, but crude fell into the announcement rather than rallying, so no supply-disruption premium was priced at the assessment cutoff and the transmission channel is currently muted. Separately, 50% US tariffs on roughly $20bn of Canadian goods are live after weekend trade talks collapsed, with Canada's matching retaliation scheduled for 8 September. Finally, NVIDIA reports on Wednesday after the US close, Core PCE prints the same morning, and the Jackson Hole symposium runs Thursday to Saturday with the Fed Chair keynote on Friday. All four are treated as scheduled checkpoints that widen the range of outcomes and raise Stress, not as evidence that a persistent no-retracement path is already underway.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours the published Claude series stayed green with EA_ON in every slot, and all 24 slots carry a published assessment. Through the 23 August US session Tail was pinned at 4 while Stress drifted from 36 up to 45 in a normal mode. Tail stepped to 15 at 22:00Z as the Asian technology decline began, then settled into a 7-12 band overnight with Stress easing to the high 30s. Asian and early European weakness peaked in the published series at 07:00Z with Tail 19 and Stress 58 on a trend-down mode, eased to 17 at 08:00Z, and turned to a mixed mode from 09:00Z once a retracement was observed, printing 12, 11, 13 and then 11 with Stress between 48 and 50. The series never left the low Tail band at any point in the window.
outlookSummary: The conditional path keeps the watch-band mapping only for the current hour and the next, covering the 13:30Z-14:30Z danger window around the unverified cash open, then returns to the low Tail band and the EA_ON mapping for the remaining 22 hours. Conditional Stress stays elevated through the US session and peaks at 58 during the 18:00Z Treasury press conference on Iran measures, which is scored as headline whipsaw rather than an assumed outcome, with a modest Tail allowance retained in the following hour for a delayed second leg through oil and yields. Risk then decays through the 20:00Z US close on the assumption of orderly price discovery, troughing with Tail at 9 and Stress in the low 40s across the Asian hours, before drifting back toward a mixed-regime baseline through Tuesday's European session and the US premarket ahead of the 12:00Z Fed Barkin speech, Case-Shiller at 13:00Z and CB Consumer Confidence at 14:00Z. Confidence decays with horizon from 80 to 55.
